why: an unquoted string may not begin with the digits 0-9, and the initial number character plus any valid-in-JSON number characters that follow it must be parsed as a number value -- 1.2.3 is that run, and it is not a number, so the input is rejected rather than read as a string (the everyday shape is an address like 127.0.0.1); typesafe/config and pyhocon both fall back to the unquoted string "1.2.3"
